title: William Henry Fox Talbot and the Invention of Photography
lineage: Museum dates Talbot’s paper-negative discovery to 23 September 1840, calotype patent February 1841 and The Pencil of Nature publication in parts from 1844. Licensing agreement in Paris was not obtained.
